#!/usr/bin/env bash # Collects SMTP/network diagnostics for a given SMTP host # Usage: ./scripts/smtp_debug.sh smtp.example.com
set -eu
SMTP_HOST=${1:-smtp6.relay.iad3b.emailsrvr.com} LOGDIR=/tmp OUTFILE="$LOGDIR/smtp-debug-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).txt" TIMEOUT_CMD="timeout 8s"
echo "SMTP debug run for: $SMTP_HOST" | tee "$OUTFILE" echo "Started at: $(date -u) (UTC)" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" echo "Hostname: $(hostname -f)" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" echo "Local IPs:" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" ip -4 addr show | sed -n '1,200p' | tee -a "$OUTFILE"
echo -e "\n=== DNS resolution ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" echo "dig A:" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" dig +short "$SMTP_HOST" | tee -a "$OUTFILE"
echo "dig ANY (caution):" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" dig +nocmd "$SMTP_HOST" any +noall +answer | tee -a "$OUTFILE"
echo -e "\n=== MX for your sending domain (replace example.com if needed) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" echo "Run: dig +short MX your.domain" | tee -a "$OUTFILE"
echo -e "\n=== TCP port probes (nc) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" for PORT in 25 587 465; do echo -e "\n-- nc -vz $SMTP_HOST $PORT --" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" $TIMEOUT_CMD nc -vz "$SMTP_HOST" $PORT 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true done
echo -e "\n=== OpenSSL STARTTLS (587) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" $TIMEOUT_CMD openssl s_client -starttls smtp -crlf -connect "$SMTP_HOST":587 </dev/null 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p' | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true
echo -e "\n=== OpenSSL SMTPS (465) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" $TIMEOUT_CMD openssl s_client -connect "$SMTP_HOST":465 -crlf </dev/null 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p' | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true
echo -e "\n=== telnet probe (25) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" $TIMEOUT_CMD bash -c "(echo EHLO $(hostname -s); sleep 1) | telnet $SMTP_HOST 25" 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p' | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true
echo -e "\n=== traceroute to host (TCP port 25) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" if command -v traceroute >/dev/null 2>&1; then # Use TCP traceroute if available traceroute -T -p 25 "$SMTP_HOST" 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true else echo "traceroute not found" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" fi
echo -e "\n=== Router/gateway / iptables / ufw ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "sudo iptables -L -n --line-numbers" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" sudo iptables -L -n --line-numbers 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true echo -e "\nCheck nftables:" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" sudo nft list ruleset 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p' | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true echo -e "\nUFW status:" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" sudo ufw status verbose 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true else echo "sudo not available for firewall checks; run iptables/nft/ufw manually as root" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" fi
echo -e "\n=== Local listeners (ss) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" ss -ltnp 2>&1 | egrep ":25 |:465 |:587 " || ss -ltnp 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true
echo -e "\n=== Check cloud provider outbound filter (simple external probe) ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" echo "Trying to connect to smtp.gmail.com:25 and :587" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" for HOST in smtp.gmail.com; do for PORT in 25 587; do echo "nc -vz $HOST $PORT" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" $TIMEOUT_CMD nc -vz $HOST $PORT 2>&1 | tee -a "$OUTFILE" || true done done
echo -e "\n=== Summary lines to search for ===" | tee -a "$OUTFILE" echo "Search the logfile for: '554', 'Connection refused', 'failed to open TCP connection', 'Net::SMTP'" | tee -a "$OUTFILE"
echo -e "\nOutput saved to: $OUTFILE" | tee -a "$OUTFILE"
# Print the path for convenience echo "$OUTFILE"
exit 0
